text:
```yaml
name: Update lint config

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 1'  # Mondays at 00:00 UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  update-lint-config:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Configure Git
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

      - name: Download latest .golangci.yml from Terragrunt
        run: |
          curl -sSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gruntwork-io/terragrunt/main/.golangci.yml -o .golangci.yml.tmp
          if ! cmp -s .golangci.yml.tmp .golangci.yml; then
            echo "Config changed"
            mv .golangci.yml.tmp .golangci.yml
            echo "changed=true" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          else
            echo "Config unchanged"
            rm .golangci.yml.tmp
            echo "changed=false" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          fi

      - name: Commit changes if any
        if: env.changed == 'true'
        run: |
          git add .golangci.yml
          git commit -m "chore: update lint config from upstream"
          BRANCH=update-lint-config-$(date +%s)
          echo "BRANCH=$BRANCH" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          git checkout -b $BRANCH
          git push --set-upstream origin $BRANCH

      - name: Create Pull Request
        if: env.changed == 'true'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          branch: ${{ env.BRANCH }}
          base: main
          title: "chore: update lint config from upstream"
          body: |
            This PR updates the local `.golangci.yml` with the latest version from the upstream Terragrunt repository.
```
